_comment: An example egg to adapt: the server's files come from a DeltaPatcher release and are brought up to date on every start, downloading only what changed. Change the docker image, the start command and the done text for your game. Import: admin panel, Nests, Import Egg.
name: Game server (files from DeltaPatcher)
author: deltapatcher@example.com
description: A game server whose files come from a DeltaPatcher release. Every start updates them first: only what changed is downloaded, and files the server made itself (configs, saves) are kept. The release's address and publisher key, or a project file from the publisher uploaded to the server folder.
startup: if [ -n "${DP_PROJECT_FILE}" ]; then ./deltapatcher-cli --no-log --close update /home/container --project-file "${DP_PROJECT_FILE}" ${DP_PROJECT_NAME:+--only "$DP_PROJECT_NAME"}; else ./deltapatcher-cli --no-log --close update /home/container --source "${DP_SOURCE}" ${DP_TRUST_KEY:+--trust-key $DP_TRUST_KEY}; fi; ./${SERVER_START}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Runs once, when the server is installed: the DeltaPatcher command line, then the release's files (from a
# project file once it is in the server folder; else the first start brings them).
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl
cd /mnt/server
curl -fsSL https://github.com/2cwldys/deltapatcher/releases/latest/download/deltapatcher-cli-linux-x64.tar.gz | tar -xz
chmod +x deltapatcher-cli
if [ -n "${DP_PROJECT_FILE}" ] && [ -f "${DP_PROJECT_FILE}" ]; then
    ./deltapatcher-cli --no-log --close update /mnt/server --project-file "${DP_PROJECT_FILE}" ${DP_PROJECT_NAME:+--only "${DP_PROJECT_NAME}"}
    echo "Installed from the project file ${DP_PROJECT_FILE}"
elif [ -n "${DP_PROJECT_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "Installed: upload ${DP_PROJECT_FILE} to the server folder, and the first start brings the files"
elif [ -n "${DP_SOURCE}" ]; then
    ./deltapatcher-cli --no-log --close update /mnt/server --source "${DP_SOURCE}" ${DP_TRUST_KEY:+--trust-key "${DP_TRUST_KEY}"}
    echo "Installed from ${DP_SOURCE}"
else
    echo "Installed without files: set the release address, or a project file"
fi

variables.name: Release address
variables.description: Where your DeltaPatcher release is: the address players use, for example https://game.example.com/. Empty when the server uses a project file.

variables.name: Publisher key
variables.description: Your publisher key (ed25519:...) when you sign releases: only releases signed with it are installed. Empty: unsigned releases are fine.

variables.name: Project file
variables.description: Instead of the release address and publisher key: a project file from the publisher (.deltapatch or .html) uploaded to the server folder, for example game.deltapatch. Its address and publisher key are used, its signature checked. Upload a newer one, and the next start uses it.

variables.name: Project in the file
variables.description: With a project file that holds several projects: the name of the one this server keeps.

variables.name: Start command
variables.description: The file that starts the server, inside the server folder.
